notes: Flaky pool: the dataset of Hashemi, Tahir, Rasheed, 'An Empirical Study of Flaky Tests in JavaScript' (ICSME 2022, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6673741) is the public dataset of JavaScript flaky tests used first: each project is pinned at the parent of a commit that fixes a flaky test. It covers only 18 projects, most of which do not run their suites with Jest or Vitest (Node core, Atom, Electron, Meteor, jQuery/QUnit, Karma suites), so it cannot supply 25 projects; the pool is completed with popular projects that have GitHub issues documenting flaky Jest/Vitest tests, each pinned at the last commit before the issue was opened.
The JS-TOD (order-dependent Jest tests) and environmental-flakiness replication packages were not fetched.
Only GitHub-hosted runners were used; numbers labelled NOISY come from shared virtual machines.
